voltage.label: Voltage
voltage.note: 110 V +/- 10%: red below 99 V or above 121 V. Yellow within 5 V of those limits (99-104 V and 116-121 V), green 104-116 V.

current.label: Current
current.note: Green below 10 A - 10%, red above 10 A + 10%, yellow in between.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.note: Green up to 60 C, yellow above 60 C, red above 66 C (overheat limit confirmed by the lab).
